mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the reflex pathways to the body made the construction meaningful: the planned paired views show how eye movement steadies a view during a head turn, while posture also adjusts.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the two finished balance organs was straightforward but added little explanation beyond placing them beside the cochlea.

surprise.text: The planned comparison of a tilted head with the start of forward motion clarified that the weighted organs respond to gravity and changes in straight-line motion, rather than steady motion itself.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though combining the two organ sets was mainly an assembly step rather than an informative decision.

continue.text: I would continue: the final connection between sensory structures and familiar eye and posture responses made me curious about other integrated functions. The choices here were mostly predictable, however.
